name: Arches
tagline: Two thousand stone arches over red slickrock desert

reservation.note: Timed-entry ticket required 7 am–4 pm, Apr 1–Oct 31. Book on Recreation.gov ($2); releases 1 month ahead, next-day tickets at 7 pm MT.

gates: Main entrance — US-191, 5 mi N of Moab (the only gate)
parking: Lots at Devils Garden, Delicate Arch and the Windows fill by 8 am in summer — enter before 7 am or after 3 pm.

aug.note: Afternoon monsoon thunderstorms possible; hike before 10 am.

camping.name: Devils Garden Campground
camping.status: Book 6 mo ahead — Aug sells out

fast: Rocky Mountain Power DCFC — 50 kW (Center St)
slow: L2 at Hyatt Place, Hoodoo & Field Station hotels

alerts.title: Timed entry in effect
alerts.body: Vehicles need a timed-entry ticket 7 am–4 pm through Oct 31. No ticket: enter before 7 am or after 4 pm.

alerts.title: Extreme heat advisory
alerts.body: Highs near 100°F. Carry 1 gal water/person/day; Delicate Arch trail has zero shade.

alerts.title: Fiery Furnace — permit only
alerts.body: Entry by ranger-led tour or self-guided permit from Recreation.gov only.

items.text: Enter before ticket hours; drive the 18-mi scenic road while it’s cool
Devils Garden Trail — Landscape Arch, on to Double O if energetic (2–7 mi)
Picnic + siesta in Moab (Sweet Cravings; galleries on Main St)
Delicate Arch hike (3 mi) — arrive for golden hour, headlamp for the walk down
Sunrise at the Windows — Turret Arch through North Window
Double Arch, then Balanced Rock stop
Park Avenue walk (1 mi one-way) before the heat
Panorama Point, then dinner in Moab (Desert Bistro)
Fiery Furnace ranger tour (reserve weeks ahead) or Tower Arch via Salt Valley Rd (high clearance)
Colorado Riverway (Hwy 128) drive; stargazing — the park is IDA dark-sky certified

name: Grand Teton
tagline: A granite rampart rising 7,000 feet off the valley floor

reservation.note: No park-entry reservation. Jenny Lake boat shuttle and Snake River floats sell out — book ahead.

parking: Jenny Lake and Lupine Meadows lots full by 9 am; String Lake by 10. Start early or use the start-of-day shuttle from Jackson.

airports.name: Jackson Hole
airports.drive: 20 min to Moose gate — inside the park boundary
airports.note: Nonstops from DEN, SLC, ORD, LAX & more

aug.note: Cold mornings — pack layers. Afternoon thunderstorms build over the range.

lodging.name: The Virginian Lodge
lodging.note: Good value 15 min from Moose gate

slow: L2 at Jackson Lake Lodge, Colter Bay & Teton Village

alerts.title: Bear activity — food storage required
alerts.body: Grizzlies frequent Jenny Lake & Cascade Canyon. Carry bear spray; store all food in lockers.

alerts.title: Moose–Wilson Road construction
alerts.body: Single-lane traffic with 20-min delays; closed to RVs and trailers.

alerts.title: Fire danger: VERY HIGH
alerts.body: Campfires in established fire rings only; no fires in the backcountry.

items.text: Jenny Lake boat shuttle (first boats) → Hidden Falls & Inspiration Point
Continue into Cascade Canyon — moose habitat (turn around anytime)
Craig Thomas Discovery Center, Menors Ferry stroll
Sunset from Signal Mountain summit road
Sunrise at Schwabacher Landing — Tetons mirrored in the beaver ponds
Taggart & Bradley Lakes loop (5.9 mi)
Jackson Lake Lodge deck — huckleberry cocktail, moose-watch over Willow Flats
Mormon Row & Moulton Barns for evening light
Oxbow Bend early light, then Colter Bay lakeshore walk
Snake River scenic float (Deadmans Bar → Moose) — book ahead
String Lake swim / paddle
Dinner in Jackson; town square arches

flex.title: Flex day — earn a summit view

items.text: Surprise & Amphitheater Lakes (10.1 mi, 3,000 ft) or Phelps Lake loop via the LSR Preserve
Granite Hot Springs (Gros Ventre) or a lazy Jackson afternoon

name: Canyonlands
tagline: A wilderness of canyons carved by the Colorado and Green

reservation.note: No entry reservation. White Rim Road day-use permits via Recreation.gov.

gates: Island in the Sky — 40 min from Moab
parking: Island in the Sky lots rarely fill except Mesa Arch at sunrise — arrive 45 min early for a tripod spot.

airports.name: Canyonlands Regional (Moab)
airports.drive: 35 min to Island in the Sky

aug.note: No water available in the park — carry everything in.

gas: None in park — fill in Moab

alerts.title: Extreme heat & no water
alerts.body: No potable water at Island in the Sky. 1 gal/person/day minimum.

alerts.title: Shafer Trail — high clearance only
alerts.body: 4WD, high clearance required; impassable when wet.

items.text: Mesa Arch at sunrise — the canonical shot
Grand View Point rim walk (2 mi)
Upheaval Dome overlooks, Green River Overlook
Dead Horse Point State Park for sunset ($20 separate)
Drive to Needles (90 min); Newspaper Rock stop
Chesler Park viewpoint hike (5.4 mi)
Pothole Point, drive back via Wilson Arch
White Rim Rd by 4WD/mtb (permit) or a Colorado River flat-water paddle

name: Yellowstone
tagline: Half the world’s geysers on a living supervolcano

reservation.note: No entry reservation — but in-park lodging and camping book ~13 months out.

parking: Old Faithful & Midway Geyser Basin lots jam 10 am–4 pm; do geysers at dawn.

aug.note: Freezing overnight lows possible at altitude.

gas: In-park: Old Faithful, Canyon, Fishing Bridge, Mammoth
slow: L2 at Canyon Lodge & Old Faithful Snow Lodge

alerts.title: Bison on roadways
alerts.body: Stay 25 yd from bison & elk, 100 yd from bears and wolves. Expect animal jams.

alerts.title: Craig Pass night closures
alerts.body: Old Faithful–West Thumb segment closed 10 pm–6 am for paving.

items.text: Old Faithful + Upper Geyser Basin boardwalks before crowds
Grand Prismatic — Fairy Falls overlook trail
Fountain Paint Pot, Firehole Lake Drive
Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone — Artist Point & brink of Lower Falls
Hayden Valley wildlife drive (bison, grizzly odds best at dusk/dawn)
Yellowstone Lake shore, West Thumb Geyser Basin
Lamar Valley — the American Serengeti (wolves at dawn)
Mammoth Hot Springs terraces
Boiling River overlook, Roosevelt Arch
Mount Washburn hike (6.8 mi) or a ranger-led Lake cruise

name: Zion
tagline: Sandstone walls a half-mile high over the Virgin River

reservation.note: Angels Landing requires a permit (Recreation.gov seasonal + day-before lotteries). Canyon is shuttle-only Mar–Nov.

parking: Visitor-center lot fills by 7:30 am; park in Springdale and ride the town shuttle in.

aug.note: Flash-flood season — check Narrows forecast every morning.

alerts.title: Flash-flood watch — the Narrows
alerts.body: Monsoon storms can raise the Virgin River in minutes. Narrows closes when flow >150 CFS.

alerts.title: Angels Landing permit required
alerts.body: Permit checked at Scout Lookout. Day-before lottery closes 3 pm MT.

items.text: First shuttle in; Riverside Walk & lower Narrows wade
The Grotto, lunch at Zion Lodge lawn
Emerald Pools loop; Canyon Junction bridge sunset
Angels Landing (permit) or Scout Lookout (no permit)
Zion–Mt. Carmel scenic drive, Canyon Overlook Trail
Dinner in Springdale (Oscar’s Cafe)
Full Narrows top-down (permit) or quiet Kolob Canyons — Timber Creek overlook

name: Rocky Mountain
tagline: Alpine tundra and elk meadows astride the Continental Divide
fee: $30 / vehicle · 1 day ($35 with Bear Lake Rd)

reservation.note: Timed-entry reservation required 9 am–2 pm (park-wide) and 5 am–6 pm (Bear Lake corridor), May 23–Oct 13. Recreation.gov.

parking: Bear Lake lot fills by 5:30 am — use the Park & Ride shuttle.

aug.note: Daily 1 pm lightning over the tundra — summit by noon.

fast: Loveland Supercharger — 250 kW, en route from DEN
slow: L2 at Estes Park visitor center & Stanley Hotel

alerts.title: Timed entry in effect
alerts.body: Two permit types: park-wide (9–2) and Bear Lake corridor (5–6). Book at 8 am MT, 1st of prior month.

alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road weather holds
alerts.body: US-34 above treeline closes temporarily for storms — check status before crossing to Grand Lake.

items.text: Bear Lake sunrise; Emerald Lake trail (3.6 mi) before crowds
Alberta Falls, Sprague Lake wheel-friendly loop
Elk watching, Moraine Park meadow
Trail Ridge Road — Many Parks Curve to the Alpine Visitor Center (12,183 ft)
Tundra Communities Trail; watch for pika & marmots
Down by noon-ish (lightning); Holzwarth Historic Site on the west side
Sky Pond via Loch Vale (9 mi) or Chasm Lake below Longs Peak
